scope: Use only the native common-line development layouts in the completed 666-record census. Keep the original job, kerf, margins, stock, quantity, spacing and reserved holes.
construction: Keep the complete contents of one archived sheet. Supply the remaining inventory from a horizontal band of any archived sheet from the same job and kerf. Remove surplus instances, renumber identical copies and translate the entire band vertically by a multiple of the validator grid. Both source sheets may come from the same layout.
selection: Choose the smallest occupied band height for each of the four job and kerf combinations. Retain source identities, full layout, and original request. Independently validate and export the four complete proposals through the public CLI.
scope_of_result: This retrospective check can produce a feasible layout under the current design. It does not count as a timed solver run or an H5 pass.
